facts.headline: Did Super Bowl Bettors Finance the $LIBRA Rugpull?
facts.summary: Argentina's President Javier Milei faces legal scrutiny after the $LIBRA memecoin he promoted collapsed within hours, wiping out buyers. The timeline, the role of Super Bowl betting liquidity, and the insider cashout point to an engineered rugpull—and arguably the first crypto-driven political crisis.
